'''Philosophy''' is a tier three [[technology]] that unlocks the [[Mind Bender]], Literacy, and the [[Tower of Wisdom|Genius task]]. 

[[File:Mind bender.png|thumb|The Mind Bender model]]
The Mind Bender is a [[unit]] that can convert enemy units and heal friendly units. For the [[Cymanti]] tribe, Philosophy unlocks the [[Shaman]] special unit instead of the Mind Bender. 

The Genius task is to research all technology; successful completion of the task grants the [[Tower of Wisdom]] monument. 

Philosophy was introduced in [[Update History##1.7_.22Power.22_Mar_31.2C_2017|update 1.7]]. 

== Literacy ==

[[File:Literacy.png|thumb|The Literacy icon]]
'''Literacy''' reduces the cost of all [[Technology|technologies]] by 33%.

In beta, Philosophy unlocked the [[Library]], a building that decreased the costs of technologies. The Library was scrapped and replaced by Literacy before release. 

Prior to update 2.0.44, the discount provided by Literacy was 20% instead of 33%.
